name: Loving Your Husband
overview: Scripture teaches that loving your husband involves a committed, God-ordained union where husband and wife become one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. A wife’s love is expressed through respectful submission to her husband, reflecting reverence for the Lord (Ephesians 5:22), while cultivating trust and confidence in him as described in Proverbs 31:11. This love is grounded in sound doctrine (Titus 2:1) and honors the sanctity of marriage, recognizing the serious implications of marital unfaithfulness and separation outlined in Deuteronomy 24:1.
